purpose: RNG-free v4 benchmark-bound host/filesystem/environment/bit-identity qualification and conservative multi-host receipt combine.
consumers: Versioned qualification receipts, reference calibration and readiness/capacity reports for owner review; does not authorize a research run.
side_effects: Explicit target scratch files/subprocesses/flock/fsync/rename probes; optional HMAC key read; developer calibration and receipt/report writes; no database/provider/trading access
necessity: Keep exact version-bound research/recovery evidence lineage; disconnected from runtime intentionally; merging duplicates would invalidate tool/source/receipt bindings.
issue: No confirmed bounded defect in normal frozen design. Throughput is calibrated estimate, fsync probe cannot prove power-loss durability, same-kernel peer never establishes cross-host flock, quick receipts rejected for qualification. Memory cap max(1,...) can still nominate one worker when calculated headroom bound is zero: proposal should require explicit future capacity review, not allocation/admission authority. Receipt paths intentionally replace per-label reports; frozen stored evidence not edited in review.
inspection: Full v4 source read in chunks; v3 complete common bodies and all 263-line unified differences independently inspected, so full source responsibilities accounted.
costs_removal: Full qualification intentionally substantial: fresh FastMetric processes, 300-draw calibration, CPU ladder, synthetic arithmetic fixtures and local races. Review runs no full host qualification or performance campaign.
design_boundary: SDD §§13.5–13.11 and 14.2: exact evidence, reproducible versions and separate owner authority. Qualification/capacity evidence cannot spend validation error budgets or authorize trading.
evidence_type: source contract; 71 selected original binding/receipt/combine/ladder tests passed, 41 intentionally deselected, plus one explicit passing deleted-inventory defect witness

Existing runner manifests and owner gates remain separate containment. Docstring describes own hash pins broader than the three-entry EXPECTED map; layer runner verifies its own required inputs.
costs_removal: Small arithmetic token fixture and git subprocesses only when invoked.
